name: toolkit
description: Optional utilities for the workshop: html-artifact (reports, plans, architecture explanations, and interactive product targets), anatomy (launches pinned upstream interactive isometric figures on demand), ketchup (catches up on current work and human decisions), web-demo-video (Playwright walkthroughs with verification frames), get-pr-comments (triages a PR's feedback into a prioritized action list, read-only), adopt-global-rules (installs the workshop's shipped global CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, rules, and Claude output styles onto a machine, additively), me-human (dogfood a system from a human user's perspective), test-audit (gates new tests and audits or prunes low-value ones), dependency-audit (audits and upgrades dependencies, and responds to security incidents across selected project and machine software with verified fixes), grill-me (a relentless interview that sharpens a plan, run by grilling), improve-codebase-architecture (finds deepening refactors using Workbench's codebase-design and domain-modeling), correct (prevents recurring repository mistakes), and benchmark-checklist (validates performance comparisons). Install alongside workbench when you want them; skip to keep sessions lean.
